create_TopK: create a TopK MoE routing module with grouped top-k and shared expert support for SGLang
build_TopKConfig: build a TopKConfig dataclass to configure top-k routing parameters like renormalize and scoring function
run_select_experts: run select_experts to dispatch tokens to top-k experts using softmax or sigmoid scoring on GPU or CPU
test_TopKOutput: test TopKOutput format checking with StandardTopKOutput, TritonKernelTopKOutput, and BypassedTopKOutput types
review_grouped_topk: review grouped_topk_gpu to select experts in expert groups using masked scoring for DeepSeek V2/V3 models
